name: discord_send_webhook
description: POSTS IN PUBLIC: send a message through a channel webhook, with no bot and no permissions — the webhook URL is the whole credential, and it can only ever reach the one channel it was made for (Channel -> Edit Channel -> Integrations -> Webhooks). Store the URL with `degen-portal auth set DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL`. Returns the created message. Mentions never notify anyone.

content.description: The message text, up to 2000 characters.

username.description: Override the webhook's display name for this message.

avatar_url.description: Override the webhook's avatar for this message.
